rationale: dual_domain-claude-agentic: epochs=80, lr=5e-05, batch_size=1, unet_c=24, train_n=50, val_n=5, rationale=iter-9: KNOB=epochs: 50→80 + lr 1e-4→5e-5 (super-patient training). iter-8 (50 ep, lr=1e-4) SSIM 0.469 — best yet, inching toward the FBP baseline ~0.47. Hypothesis: with slow lr + long training, N2I supervision may distill clean signal — 80 ep × 50 train slabs = 4000 gradient steps at lr=5e-5 = effectively 50 ep at lr=1e-4 but with finer steps.
